       SUBJ: AMBASSADOR'S FAREWELL CALL ON PRESIDENT BALAGUER

          1. (CONFIDENTIAL - ENTIRE TEXT)

          2. COMMENT: I PROVIDE THIS REPORT WITH SOME
       HESITATION, GIVEN ITS CONTENT, BUT I DO SO FOLLOWING MY
      PRACTICE DURING NEARLY THREE AND ONE HALF YEARS IN
      SANTO DOMINGO OF TREATING EVERY PRIVATE MEETING WITH
      PRESIDENT BALAGUER AS POTENTIALLY INTERESTING TO THE
      DEPARTMENT AND THEREFORE OBLIGATORY TO REPORT. END
      COMMENT.

          3. ON JANUARY 2, I MADE MY FAREWELL CALL ON PRESIDENT
                 CONFIDENTIAL


                 CONFIDENTIAL

      PAGE 02   SANTO 00080 032126Z
      JOAQUIN BALAGUER. HE OPENED THE ONE-ON-ONE MEETING BY
      SAYING HE WOULD BE SORRY TO SEE ME LEAVE BECAUSE, HE
        SAID, I HAD BEEN THE BEST AMERICAN AMBASSADOR IN THE
      DOMINICAN REPUBLIC FOR MANY YEARS. HE SAID I HAD
      CONVEYED TO DOMINICANS A SINCERE INTEREST IN THEIR
      COUNTRY'S DEVELOPMENT AND PROGRESS AND A CONSISTENT
       WILLINGNESS TO BE HELPFUL TOWARD THOSE ENDS.

          4.   I THANKED HIM FOR THOSE GENEROUS COMMENTS AND
      MENTIONED THAT THE OPPORTUNITY TO KNOW AND WORK WITH
       HIM HAD BEEN A SINGULAR HONOR. HE WAS AMONG THE
      HEMISPHERE'S MOST DISTINGUISHED STATESMEN NOT ONLY
      BECAUSE OF THE LONGEVITY OF HIS TENURE (COMMENT: A
      REFERENCE WHICH CAUSED HIM TO CHUCKLE) BUT ALSO BECAUSE
      OF THE STYLE IN WHICH HE HAD LED. HIS ABILITY TO
       MAINTAIN TRANQUILITY IN THE FACE OF SERIOUS CRISES AND
      TO CARRY OUT POLICY REFORMS HAD BEEN IMPRESSIVE.

                            REVIEW AUTHORITY:  Charles Daris, Senior Reviewer

UNCLASSIFIED U.S. Department of State Case No. M-2014-23169 Doc No. C05706239 Date: 11/22/2017

          5. PRESIDENT BALAGUER SAID THAT MY UNPRETENTIOUS AND
      RESPECTFUL APPROACH HAD BEEN PARTICULARLY EFFECTIVE AND
      HAD WON AFFECTION FOR THE UNITED STATES.  I HAD NOT
       IRRITATED ANYONE IN THE GOVERNMENT, OR OUTSIDE IT. HIS
      COUNTRY HAD BENEFITTED FOR HAVING A HIGHLY CAPABLE
      AMBASSADOR OF STATURE REPRESENT THE UNITED STATES HERE,
      HE ADDED. (AT THIS POINT PRESIDENT BALAGUER REMARKED
      THAT HIS STATEMENTS "MIGHT NOT BE VERY PROTOCOLARY.")

         6.  I RECALLED THAT WE HAD DEALT TOGETHER ON SERIOUS
      PROBLEMS SUCH AS THE CASE OF DANIEL MIRAMBEAUX (THE
      DOMINICAN FUGITIVE CHARGED WITH MURDERING A NEW YORK
       POLICE OFFICER) AND THE GSP REVIEW OF WORKERS' RIGHTS.
                 CONFIDENTIAL

                 CONFIDENTIAL

      PAGE 03   SANTO 00080 032126Z
      PRESIDENT BALAGUER COMMENTED THERE WOULD ALWAYS BE
      PROBLEMS. WE AGREED THAT THE IMPORTANT THING WAS TO
      TRY TO WORK TOGETHER TO RESOLVE SUCH PROBLEMS RATHER
      THAN LET THEM GET CONFRONTATIONAL AND DAMAGE OUR
       RELATIONSHIP.

          7. PRESIDENT BALAGUER ADDED THAT RELATIONS BETWEEN
      LARGE COUNTRIES AND SMALL COUNTRIES WERE OFTEN
       DIFFICULT.  I RESPONDED THAT THAT MIGHT BE THE CASE,
      BUT BIG COUNTRIES DID NOT ALWAYS POSSESS BY THEMSELVES
       ALL THE WISDOM THEY NEEDED, AND SMALL COUNTRIES WERE
      NOT ALWAYS LACKING IN RESOURCES. DOMINICANS, FOR
      EXAMPLE, HAD INSIGHTS INTO DEVELOPMENTS IN HAITI IN
      WHICH WE WERE INTERESTED BECAUSE OF THE DOMINICANS'
       PHYSICAL PROXIMITY TO HAITI AND THE CLOSENESS WITH
      WHICH THEY FOLLOWED THEIR NEIGHBOR. PRESIDENT BALAGUER
      ACKNOWLEDGED HIS ABIDING INTEREST IN HAITI AND PRAISED
      CURRENT U.S. POLICY FOR MAINTAINING PRESSURE BUT NOT
      BEING SO INSISTENT ON A SPECIFIC OUTCOME AS TO DENY
       HAITIANS THE SPACE THEY NEEDED TO FIND SOLUTIONS.

          8. COMMENT: PRESIDENT BALAGUER'S REMARKS EXPAND ON
       SIMILARLY GRACIOUS COMMENTS HE MADE DECEMBER 13 WHEN I
      INTRODUCED THE DCM. THEY CONTAIN AN ELEMENT OF LATIN
      HYPERBOLE. PRESIDENT BALAGUER'S ATTITUDE MAY BE A
      REACTION TO OUR MISSION PROGRAM PLAN IN WHICH THE
      COUNTRY TEAM'S OVERARCHING GOAL HAS BEEN TO REDUCE THE
      EXCESSIVE DOMINICAN SENSE OF DEPENDENCE ON THE UNITED
       STATES. WE HAVE WORKED TO ENCOURAGE DOMINICANS TO TAKE
       RESPONSIBILITY FOR THEIR OWN AFFAIRS AND TRIED WHEN
      POSSIBLE NOT TO PRESCRIBE SOLUTIONS OR CRITICIZE
                 CONFIDENTIAL

                 CONFIDENTIAL

          4. "DR CAN ACCEPT ONLY LIMITED NUMBER OF HAITIANS"

      POPULATION BE TRANSFERRED TO GUYANA OR ANOTHER
      APPROPRIATE PLACE. HE THINKS MANY LATIN AMERICAN

       IMMIGRANTS.

      SEVERAL DAYS RECENTLY), INFLATION AND GOVERNMENT

     HOW IT WILL COME OUT, BUT BALAGUER'S STRENGTHS AND
      BOSCH'S WEAKNESSES SEEM TO MANY OBSERVERS LESS
      COMPELLING IN 1990 THAN IN PREVIOUS CONTESTS.

          4. THE MAIN DETERMINANT IN THE PRESIDENTIAL RACE MAY
      BE THE CANDIDACY OF JOSE FRANCISCO PENA GOMEZ WHO,
      WHILE GIVEN LITTLE CHANCE OF ACHIEVING A PLURALITY,
      MAY DIVIDE THE OPPOSITION ENOUGH TO REELECT THE
       PRESIDENT. IF THE DOMINICAN REVOLUTIONARY PARTY HAD

      ELECTING PRESIDENTS FOR 24 YEARS, NO DOMINICAN

      THE PROCESS
       CONFIDENTIAL

          5. WE EXPECT THE CAMPAIGN TO PROCEED REASONABLY

      WITHOUT BLOODSHED HAS MAINTAINED DOMESTIC TRANQUILITY

      RESCHEDULE ITS DEBT, PROBABLY NEGOTIATE SOME DEBT

      BOSCH'S HOSTILITY TO THE U.S. MILITARY, WHICH HE HOLDS
      RESPONSIBLE FOR KEEPING HIM IN 1965 FROM THE
      PRESIDENCY TO WHICH HE HAD BEEN ELECTED, COULD MAKE
       HIM RELUCTANT TO CONTINUE THE GENEROUS ACCESS TO THREE

      PRESIDENT TO HEAD THE USG DELEGATION TO THE INAUGURATION
      OF DR. JOAQUIN BALAGUER AS PRESIDENT OF THE DOMINICAN
      REPUBLIC ON AUGUST 16. MY WIFE DORCAS AND I WILL BE

      A SUCCESS.

      THE SEVENTH TIME DOMINICANS HAVE GONE TO THE POLLS SINCE
      THE CURRENT DEMOCRATIC PROCESS BEGAN IN 1966. THE
      DOMINICAN REPUBLIC IS THUS ONE OF THE OLDEST DEMOCRACIES
        IN LATIN AMERICA, AND DEMOCRATIC PRINCIPLES HAVE BEGUN
      TO TAKE ROOT. THOSE ROOTS ARE NOT YET DEEP, HOWEVER,
      AND THE PROCESS HAS YET TO BE FULLY INSTITUTIONALIZED.
     POWER HAS BEEN TRANSFERRED TWICE FROM THE GOVERNING
      PARTY TO THE OPPOSITION (FROM BALAGUER IN 1978 AND BACK
      TO HIM IN 1986), AND ON BOTH OCCASIONS THE TRANSITION
     WAS VERY DIFFICULT AND REQUIRED CONSIDERABLE

       INTERNATIONAL AS WELL AS DOMESTIC PRESSURE.

          5. THE CURRENT ELECTION WAS MARRED BY CHARGES OF FRAUD
     FROM THE OPPOSITION PARTIES. WHILE NO HARD EVIDENCE WAS
      PRODUCED, THE BARRAGE OF ALLEGATIONS AND THE AGONIZING,
      TWO-MONTH-LONG PROCESS TO DETERMINE THE WINNER LEFT THEIR
      MARK. IN THE END, BALAGUER EKED OUT ONLY A VERY NARROW
      MARGIN (1 PERCENT) OVER HIS CLOSEST RIVAL AND PERENNIAL
      OPPONENT, FORMER PRESIDENT JUAN BOSCH. BALAGUER WILL BE
      EMBARKING ON HIS NEW TERM WITH A WEAK MANDATE (HE
       ATTAINED ONLY 35 PERCENT OF THE VOTE) AND A HOSTILE
       OPPOSITION THAT, IF IT UNITES, COULD CAUSE CONSIDERABLE
      PROBLEMS OVER THE NEXT FOUR YEARS. (THE TWO MAIN
       OPPOSITION PARTIES, WHO HOLD 90 OF THE 150 SEATS IN THE
